item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Distributed accelerator for cloud storage on AKS
item.description:
Distributed accelerator for cloud storage (DACS) is now in public preview for AI workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). It runs as a distributed read-through cache within the cluster and uses local NVMe disks across nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates
